data.body: Operator decisions 2026-11-03: (i) reproducible items are in scope. Production fsck triage reproduces in part (23 untracked pre-compaction event files dated 2026-09-04 22:23:46 PDT, each with a tracked .retired copy; 2 abandoned .tmp-event staging files incl. one staged 12 s after the 2026-10-23 22:37 PDT deploy start) and is IN scope: clean both up via rebar store maintenance after confirming each leftover has a tracked .retired copy and each staged uuid was superseded, and make fsck report untracked event files as their own row kind. The stale-cache refusal did NOT reproduce (MCP reads turned fresh exactly when the server clone HEAD advanced; no TTL cache on the read/freshness path) and is OUT of scope. (ii) Deploy overlap fix: option (1), on SIGTERM the retiring container stops its compaction sweep and lets any in-flight event write finish before exit; the shared clone stays. Also in scope: idle-timer tickets sync in the MCP server and push-failure logging at the default level. AC1-AC4 are recorded as met/moot from the 2026-10-18 comment evidence. env_id_mismatch is handled by disruptive-breezy-esok (7ea86184dac).
